findings.title: Sky dome draw calls increased 12x (performance)
findings.detail: Old code collected all 12 dome ring segments into a single skyVerts array and issued one gl.drawArrays call. New code declares skyVerts inside the for(si) loop and issues separate bufferData + drawArrays per ring (12 draw calls). Each call also re-binds and re-uploads the VBO. Pre-compute per-ring colors into a single VBO with per-vertex colors and draw once.

findings.title: Cloud tint fogColor multiplied by asymmetric factors may exceed 1.0
findings.detail: Cloud color is lerp(1, fogColor[channel]*factor, t) where factor is 1.3/1.2/1.1 for R/G/B. If fogColor exceeds ~0.77 for a channel, fogColor*1.3 could exceed 1.0 before clamping. Add Math.min(fogColor[i]*factor, 1.0) guard.
